settings.heading: We find the products worth discovering.
settings.text: WEDRA is a curation brand for wellness and everyday living. We search through a lot of products, filter out the noise, and feature the few that make daily life easier, calmer or more enjoyable.

settings.heading: We choose. Others make.
settings.text: WEDRA doesn't manufacture the products we feature, and we don't put our name on things we didn't make. What we add is the selection, and an honest presentation: real photos, confirmed specifications and a clear price.

settings.title: Useful
settings.text: A product has to make an everyday routine simpler or better. Novelty alone isn't enough.

settings.title: Clear
settings.text: You should understand what it does and what you get at a glance. We only publish details we can confirm.

settings.title: Fair
settings.text: No invented reviews, countdown timers or pressure. Just the product, shown well.

settings.heading: One discovery today. More to come.
settings.text: We're starting with a single featured product and adding the next only when we find one worth showing you.

settings.heading: Be the first to see what we find next.
settings.text: An occasional email when there is something worth showing you. Nothing more.
